'''Malkor Trel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Malkor Trel worked for the Rebel Alliance as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and at some point prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], he infiltrated the crew of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. He obtained a position working in the ship's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] pool as a droid [[Technician/Legends|technician]], and obtained data for the Alliance regarding the deployment of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Fleet]]. However, in 3 ABY [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanith Sorn]], one of the ''Executor''s [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]], discovered evidence that Trel was working for the Alliance, so Trel reprogrammed four [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Sorn.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] assembled a team of ''Executor'' crew members to investigate Sorn's death and during their investigations, they interviewed Trel, whom they considered to be a suspect. Shortly afterwards, the Alliance [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] ''[[Onderian Raptor]]'' arrived on the ''Executor'', to attempt to extract Trel. However, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] crew were neutralized and the ship impounded. Trel made his was to the ship and secretly deactivated the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] systems in the hangar in which it was located, hoping to make his escape from the ''Executor''. However, the team investigating Sorn's death realized Trel's plan and confronted him aboard the freighter. He explained to them that he was forced to kill Sorn because of his mission, and offered to take the team with him, so that they could join the Rebel Alliance.
